According to COMK’s Srikanth, the Northeast Monsoon remains active as a developing low over the Southwest Bay of Bengal triggers widespread rains. Chennai suburbs recorded 10–12 cm in 24 hours. Moderate to heavy rain may continue across KTCC, while South TN and Kerala face heavy to very heavy spells. Interior TN may also receive rainfall as the system moves west, with another low expected over the Andaman Sea.
